_meta.category: Negotiation, Persuasion, Sales Psychology & Influence — Deep Research
_meta.description: 542 data points covering salary negotiation, anchoring effects, BATNA, win-win outcomes, real estate/car/B2B negotiation, cross-cultural negotiation, hostage negotiation, Cialdini's principles, social proof, scarcity, framing effects, persuasion techniques, cold calling/emailing, sales cycles, close rates, follow-up statistics, objection handling, referral selling, pricing psychology, upsell/cross-sell, and customer retention economics. All from verifiable sources (Harvard PON, Wharton, Stanford GSB, Journal of Applied Psychology, HBR, Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, LinkedIn, FBI, APA, NBER).
sources_used: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
